_comment: Config for create_inbound_plan.py. Copy, fill in your own values, never commit real addresses.
num_boxes x per_box must equal total_qty for every SKU, otherwise Amazon rejects the packing info.
All SKUs must fit in one box type; if Amazon returns more than one packing group they cannot.
plan_name: <free-text plan name shown in Seller Central>
channel: <your freight channel name, free text, only used in the result file>

carrier._comment: Run list_carriers.py first to see the exact strings your account is offered.
carrier.name: <exact carrier name string from list_carriers.py>
